section.sectionSummaryBrief: Since in Elul the king receives everyone with a pleasant countenance, he certainly fulfills the request of every Jew for a good year and the ultimate redemption.
section.t: And since in Elul the king receives all of them with a pleasant countenance and shows a smiling face to everyone,
surely the king fulfills the request of each and every one of Israel,
that he should have a good inscription and sealing for a good and sweet year in the revealed and manifest good,
both in spiritual matters—in the study of Torah and fulfillment of the commandments—
and in material matters—in children, life, and ample sustenance—
and all the more so regarding the primary request—the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
